about: The order of the exam-paper workflow, read by scripts/next_step.py. Steps run one at a time, in this order. A step is next when every step before it is done and it is not. 'by' says who does the step; 'waitsForUser' marks the approval points where work stops until the user answers. 'done' is checked against the task folder (paths are relative to it). 'inputs' and 'outputs' are the files whose hashes next_step.py --done records when the step finishes; a 'recorded' condition is done while those inputs are unchanged and the outputs exist. Format: see next_step.py.

steps.title: Show the blueprint and get the user's approval
steps.run: Show TASK/blueprint.json as SKILL.md step 2 says, and ask the user to type /exam-papers:approve blueprint. Wait.

steps.title: Draft questions.json and its diagrams
steps.run: Start the exam-papers:writer subagent by its type in draft mode, with the paths SKILL.md step 3 lists. Wait for it to finish.

steps.title: Blind solver
steps.run: Start the exam-papers:blind-solver subagent by its type with only two paths: input TASK/review/solver-input.json and output TASK/review/solver-answers.json. Wait for it to finish.

steps.title: Compare the solver's answers with the key
steps.note: Exit code 1 means mismatches, not a failure.

steps.title: Reviewer subagent checks the paper
steps.run: Start the exam-papers:reviewer subagent by its type with the paths SKILL.md step 5.4 lists (more from round 2 on). Wait for it to finish, then show the output of python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/render_review.py" TASK/review/reviewer-report.json --print and send the user TASK/review/reviewer-report.html.

steps.title: Close the review round
steps.note: Exit code 1 means the reviewer must fix its report: start it again with the message.

steps.title: The user decides on the open findings
steps.run: Show python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/review_status.py" TASK and the findings it lists under 'Teacher to decide' and 'Disputes' (SKILL.md step 5.6), and ask the user to type /exam-papers:decide accept ... reject ... covering each of them. Wait.

steps.title: The writer addresses the findings
steps.run: Start the exam-papers:writer subagent by its type in revise mode, with the IDs python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/review_status.py" TASK lists under 'Writer to address' and 'Writer to revert' and the rest SKILL.md step 5.7 lists. Wait for it to finish, show the user TASK/review/writer-response.json, and carry on without waiting.

steps.title: Approve the final paper
steps.run: Show the finished paper and the output of python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/review_status.py" TASK --fixes (SKILL.md step 5.8), and ask the user to type /exam-papers:approve paper, or /exam-papers:decide reject ID to undo a fix. Wait.

steps.title: Deliver the PDFs
steps.run: Send both PDFs to the user with the path of TASK and any warnings that remain.
